statue-liberty.name: Statue of Liberty
statue-liberty.price_text: ≈ USD 25–30 ferry and grounds ticket; crown and pedestal cost extra
statue-liberty.hours: Ferries usually run morning to late afternoon; check the day's schedule
statue-liberty.tip: Book ferry tickets online weeks ahead. Arrive for the first boat to beat the crowds.

ellis-island.name: Ellis Island
ellis-island.price_text: Included in the Statue of Liberty ferry ticket
ellis-island.hours: Same hours as the ferry service; check on the day
ellis-island.tip: The immigration museum is included with the ferry. Allow an extra hour to look up family records.
ellis-island.best: Same trip as the Statue of Liberty

empire-state.name: Empire State Building
empire-state.price_text: ≈ USD 44–80 depending on deck and time; check online
empire-state.tip: Go up at sunset for day and night views. Buy a timed ticket online to skip the queue.

times-square.name: Times Square
times-square.tip: Come after dark for the neon. Keep moving and watch your bag in the crowds.

central-park.name: Central Park
central-park.tip: Rent a bike or walk the Mall and Bethesda Terrace. The park is huge, so pick one area.

met-museum.name: Metropolitan Museum of Art
met-museum.price_text: ≈ USD 30 adults; pay-what-you-wish for NY State residents
met-museum.hours: Usually open daily; check the day's hours
met-museum.tip: Pick two or three galleries, not the whole museum. The rooftop garden is worth a look in season.

moma.name: The Museum of Modern Art
moma.hours: Usually open daily; check the day's hours
moma.tip: Start on the top floor and work down. Van Gogh's Starry Night is a must-see.

amnh.name: American Museum of Natural History
amnh.price_text: ≈ USD 28 adults; pay-what-you-wish for NY State residents
amnh.hours: Usually open daily; check the day's hours
amnh.tip: The dinosaur halls and blue whale are the highlights. Book timed entry online.

guggenheim.name: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum
guggenheim.hours: Usually open daily; check the day's hours
guggenheim.tip: Take the lift to the top and spiral down. The building itself is the star.

brooklyn-bridge.name: Brooklyn Bridge
brooklyn-bridge.tip: Walk from Brooklyn to Manhattan in the morning for the skyline view. Stay in the marked lane.

memorial-911.name: 9/11 Memorial
memorial-911.hours: Memorial open daily; museum hours vary, check on the day
memorial-911.tip: The memorial pools are free and moving. The museum is separate and needs a ticket.

one-wtc.name: One World Trade Center
one-wtc.price_text: ≈ USD 44–50 for the observatory; check online
one-wtc.hours: Observatory usually open daily; check the day's hours
one-wtc.tip: Go on a clear day. Sunset slots sell out, so book ahead.

high-line.name: The High Line
high-line.hours: Open daily; hours vary by season, check on the day
high-line.tip: Walk south from 34th Street to Chelsea Market. Go early to avoid the crowds.

rockefeller.name: Rockefeller Center
rockefeller.price_text: Free to walk; Top of the Rock ≈ USD 40+
rockefeller.hours: Plaza always open; the ice rink runs in winter
rockefeller.tip: See the plaza and the Christmas tree in winter. Top of the Rock gives the classic Empire State view.

grand-central.name: Grand Central Terminal
grand-central.tip: Look up at the ceiling in the main concourse. The whispering gallery is by the Oyster Bar.

summit-vanderbilt.name: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt
summit-vanderbilt.price_text: ≈ USD 45–60 depending on time; check online
summit-vanderbilt.hours: Usually open daily; check the day's hours
summit-vanderbilt.tip: The mirrored rooms are the draw. Book a sunset slot and wear something you can see your feet in.

chrysler.name: Chrysler Building
chrysler.price_text: Free to see from the street; the lobby is not open to tourists
chrysler.tip: Best seen from a distance, for example from Tudor City or the street to the east.

wall-street.name: Wall Street
wall-street.tip: Walk from the Charging Bull to Federal Hall and the Stock Exchange. Weekdays are livelier.

chelsea-market.name: Chelsea Market
chelsea-market.price_text: Free to enter; food paid per stall
chelsea-market.hours: Usually open daily, roughly 07:00–21:00; check on the day
chelsea-market.tip: Come hungry and try a few stalls. It is a good stop at the end of the High Line.

broadway.name: Broadway Theater District
broadway.price_text: ≈ USD 80–200 per ticket; discounts at the TKTS booth
broadway.hours: Shows usually evening, with some matinees
broadway.tip: Buy same-day discount tickets at the TKTS booth in Times Square. Book popular shows weeks ahead.

st-patricks.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral
st-patricks.hours: Open daily; check on the day for mass times
st-patricks.tip: Step inside for the stained glass. Dress respectfully and keep quiet during services.

staten-island-ferry.name: Staten Island Ferry
staten-island-ferry.tip: A free ride past the Statue of Liberty. Stand on the right side going out for the best view.

nypl.name: New York Public Library (Main Branch)
nypl.hours: Usually open daily; check the day's hours
nypl.tip: See the Rose Main Reading Room and the stone lions outside. Free tours run on some days.

flatiron.name: Flatiron Building
flatiron.tip: Best photo spot is from Madison Square Park to the north. The building is not open inside.

smorgasburg.name: Smorgasburg food market
smorgasburg.price_text: Free to enter; food paid per stall, roughly USD 10–20 a dish
smorgasburg.hours: Weekends in season; check dates and locations on the day
smorgasburg.tip: A big open-air food market with many stalls. Go early for shorter lines.

brooklyn-heights.name: Brooklyn Heights Promenade walk
brooklyn-heights.tip: A quiet walk with skyline views. Combine it with the Brooklyn Bridge walk.

top-of-the-rock.name: Top of the Rock viewpoint
top-of-the-rock.hours: Usually open daily; check the day's hours
top-of-the-rock.tip: The best view of the Empire State Building. Go at dusk for both day and night.

greenwich-village.name: Greenwich Village walk
greenwich-village.tip: Wander the side streets around Washington Square Park. Good for coffee and people-watching.

circle-line.name: Circle Line harbour cruise
circle-line.hours: Several departures daily; check on the day
circle-line.tip: A boat tour that circles Manhattan and passes the Statue of Liberty. Sit on the open deck.
